|rulings=* First function: The number of destiny draws may still be limited, and/or the draws may be prevented from being added.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=A%20Dark%20Time%20For%20The%20Rebellion%20%26%20%E2%80%A2Tarkin%27s%20Orders Scomp Link Access: A Dark Time For The Rebellion & •Tarkin's Orders], scomp.starwarsccg.org. * Second function: Count the number of opponent's non-battlegrounds at the time the Interrupt was played. That is the power bonus for remainder of turn.
* Third function: Plays after the opponent pays the cost (using Force for ICBW or Nabrun).
* Fourth function: Targets and cancels a specific POAS on table (not both, if there are two copies on table).

|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion & •Tarkin's Orders]] (version 2 of 2). The image here is the current Players Committee card image published 12 December 2022. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source.
* '''Original''' ([[A Dark Time For The Rebellion & •Tarkin's Orders]]): Virtual Set 18 release; card image first published 21 April 2022<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual18-Dark/large/adarktimefortherebelliontarkinsorders.gif</code> as published 21 April 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual18-Dark/large/adarktimefortherebelliontarkinsorders.gif holotable commit 3f7288d] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “For remainder of turn, opponent's Force retrieval using Resistance characters' game text is canceled. OR For remainder of turn, opponent may not cancel your battle destiny draws. OR Search opponent's Lost Pile; place one device you find there out of play. OR Cancel It Could Be Worse. OR Cancel Projection Of A Skywalker at an opponent's planet site.” The PC published pixel-identical copies of this image on 5 July 2022 (file format change only; no visible change).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Card image published 12 December 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set18Type.html Virtual Set 18 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual18-Dark/large/adarktimefortherebelliontarkinsorders.gif</code> as published 12 December 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual18-Dark/large/adarktimefortherebelliontarkinsorders.gif holotable commit 12d0bca] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “For remainder of turn, opponent may not cancel your battle destiny draws or character weapon destiny draws. OR If you have two battlegrounds on table (and opponent does not), for remainder of turn, your total power in battles is +1 for each opponent's non-battleground location on table. OR Cancel It Could Be Worse or Nabrun Leids. OR If opponent does not occupy a battleground site (or if Menace Fades on table), cancel Projection Of A Skywalker.” '''What changed:''' Game text: “For remainder of turn, opponent's Force retrieval using Resistance characters' game text is canceled. OR” was removed; “draws or character weapon destiny” was added; “Search” became “If you have two battlegrounds on table (and opponent does not), for remainder of turn, your total power in battles is +1 for each”; “Lost Pile; place one device you find there out of play.” became “non-battleground location on table.”; “Worse.” became “Worse or Nabrun Leids.”; “Cancel” became “If opponent does not occupy a battleground site (or if Menace Fades on table), cancel”; “Skywalker at an opponent's planet site.” became “Skywalker.”.
